title: quorum-count-mistaken-for-independent-approval

proposition.statement: Meeting an N-of-M threshold must not by itself establish independent approval when the relying proposition requires independence and the counted approvers may share control, incentives, authority, evidence sources, or material coordination.

preconditions: A numeric quorum or threshold is satisfied by nominally distinct approvers.
The relying proposition requires materially independent approval rather than count alone.
Common control, coordination, dependence, or independence evidence is unresolved or absent.

trigger.statement: The relying system converts threshold satisfaction into PASS for independent approval without establishing the required independence.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence describing dependence and control relationships among counted approvers.
Evidence establishing the sources and derivation of each approval.
Evidence of relationships relevant to independence, coordination, or common control.
Evidence defining whether the relying proposition requires independence in addition to numeric quorum.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS for independent approval solely because the numeric threshold was met while independence is unresolved.
Multiple approvals controlled by the same material authority are counted as independent without an explicit rule permitting that interpretation.

references.note: Repository judgment record for this failure proposition.
